title: Fix the go-pkcs12 replace comment
body:
### What does this PR do?

Corrects the reason given for the `software.sslmate.com/src/go-pkcs12` replace directive.

### Motivation

The previous comment attributed the `GOPROXY=direct` failure to the upstream repository, which was wrong (see SSLMate/go-pkcs12#84).

### More

- [ ] Added/updated tests
- [ ] Added/updated documentation

### Additional Notes

Assisted-by: Claude
